title: nip98-proxy identity boundary — extended selftest
scope: Local fake-upstream proxy suite. No deployed acceptance, no live AoE daemon, no real provider and no key-persistence test against a booted image.

added_cases.spoofed_identity_header: A client that supplies the identity headers the proxy injects has them stripped and replaced by the authenticated identity, asserted on BOTH the HTTP and the WebSocket path; the upstream never observes the client-supplied value.
added_cases.absent_verifier: When the NIP-98 verifier is unavailable or throws, the proxy fails CLOSED and the upstream receives nothing.
added_cases.allowlist_removal: An identity removed from the allowlist is denied on the next request, including one carrying an already-established session cookie.
added_cases.cookie_expiry_and_restart: An expired signed-handshake cookie is rejected; a cookie minted under a previous HMAC key is rejected after restart; a control case under the current key still works. No upstream call in either rejection.
added_cases.tokenless_denial: A request with no NIP-98 header, no bearer and no cookie is denied 401 on HTTP, WS upgrade and named routes; the AoE daemon token is not injected and does not leak into the denial body.
added_cases.adr_2010_bearer: In auth.mode=nip98 the route bearer is NOT injected for named routes on HTTP or WS, while AoE still receives its daemon token in both; a bearer-only caller cannot reach a mutation route and the governance upstream is never contacted.
added_cases.adr_2011_identity: Lowercase 64-hex x-only output; npub/bech32, short and non-hex input rejected; an uppercase private hex still derives the lowercase canonical pubkey; key file mode 0600 (mint API and CLI); restart with the same key file yields the same identity; a persistence failure surfaces persisted:false rather than a silently unstable identity; no private key material in the returned identity, the CLI export, or proxy stdout/stderr (with a non-vacuousness control).

tests.stdout_tail:
PASS  M4: the returned identity carries no private key material
  PASS  M5: persistence failure surfaces persisted:false, not a silently unstable identity
  PASS  M6: deriveXonly rejects npub/bech32 input
  PASS  M6b: deriveXonly rejects a short key
  PASS  M6c: deriveXonly rejects non-hex input
  PASS  M6d: an uppercase private hex still derives the lowercase canonical pubkey
  PASS  M7: the mint CLI exports the public DID and never the private key
  PASS  M7b: CLI-minted key file is 0600
  PASS  M8: no credential material appears in proxy stdout/stderr
  PASS  M8b: child proxy logs were actually captured (the check is not vacuous)

OK — 0 failure(s), 0 skip(s)

limitations: Fake upstreams throughout. Running binary/config identity was not captured, token rotation/revocation against the real AoE daemon was not exercised, the door inventory is not bound to deployed ports and credentials, and the same-UID residual is unchanged.
